content:
tess: Quick thread for CloudForge x NovaGrid co-hosted mini-workshop (onsite + livestream) on Aug 18. Need: speaker confirmations, a crisp demo fallback ladder, and a contactless locker claim flow for swag. Who picks what?
ben: I can own speakers and the livestream panel. Need final list by Tue EOD.
olga: Marketing here. I'll run landing page, promo cadence, and collect headshots + 1-line bios. Deadline Fri.
raj: Ops will handle demo image + locker ops. Primary demo on NovaGrid rack; fallback 1 = local CPU container; fallback 2 = 90s recorded clip. Also proposing a "claimcode" locker flow to avoid booth lines.
tess: Claimcode flow idea: after registering, attendee gets a 6-digit claimcode + QR. Onsite volunteer enters code or scans QR to release locker. One claimcode per reg. Agreed?
ben: Works. Add a visible promo card in the swag so we can attribute signups. Limit one pack per reg.
venue-bot: logistics: Locker bank LB-5 available at North Hall; vendor will supply locker access codes day-of. Power outlet: G-12 nearby.
olga: Volunteer plan: 15:30-16:30 lead @raj, 16:30-17:15 backup @tess. Can CloudForge provide one person for last 15m?
raj: CloudForge confirmed Laura as a backup. I'll ship swag to venue warehouse Aug 15. Locker dimensions pending; if too small we'll fallback to staffed table + contactless scanner.
tess: Demo fallback script for moderator: 1) call primary (NovaGrid rack) 2) after 45s of failure, call "switch to local demo" 3) if still failing, play 90s clip and open to Q&A. Keep language short and calm.
ben: Dry run scheduled Aug 16 10:00 PT. Please ensure panelists can join. Ops, test locker claim flow in dry run please.
raj: Draft manifest: 
```
- 130 sticker sleeves
- 50 USB-C demo dongles (preloaded image)
- 30 mini dev kits (boxed)
- 140 one-page quickstarts
```
I'll add weights/dims and courier labels tonight.
olga: Promo schedule: Aug 1 initial, Aug 11 reminder, Aug 16 final. Avoid publishing any latency/cost numbers without legal approval. Use qualitative language.
tess: AV & tech checklist: 1x HDMI input, 1x wired ethernet, 2x HDMI adapters, spare laptop with container preloaded, locked S3 link for 90s clip. Bring a 4G hotspot as extra.
venue-bot: calendar: "CloudForge + NovaGrid Mini-Workshop" Aug 18 16:00-17:00 local time. Dry run Aug 16 10:00 PT.
raj: I'll test the claimcode mobile UI during dry run (bring spare phone + mini router). Also labeling: each locker box will have a manifest card and on-host contact.
olga: Marketing will need headshots + pronouns + short bios by Fri. I'll also want 1 sentence for the landing page about the live demo topic.
ben: Moderator notes: keep fallback transitions <30s, announce claimcode pickup window 30m before start, and remind attendees about the one-per-reg rule.
tess: Final checklist: speakers by Tue, manifest + weights by Fri, headshots/bios by Fri, slides by Aug 10, dry run Aug 16. I'll DM owners a compact checklist. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
